body.message: celld egress policy: localhost:${UPSTREAM_PORT} is not a public address, so this node refuses to connect to it. A node operator can allow it by adding localhost:${UPSTREAM_PORT} to CELLD_FETCH_PRIVATE_ALLOW.

celld egress policy: localhost.:${UPSTREAM_PORT} is not a public address, so this node refuses to connect to it. A node operator can allow it by adding localhost.:${UPSTREAM_PORT} to CELLD_FETCH_PRIVATE_ALLOW.
